clues: This town sits on a small river in a high valley. It lies in the Alps in the north of Italy.
When winter comes, crowds rush in for snow sports. The town swells from a few thousand folks to tens of thousands.
This town is old, and one year stands out in its past. In 1420, the sea power Venice took it for its own.
This ski town once hosted the whole Winter Olympics. Athletes from all over the world raced here in 1956.
In 2026 this town shared the Winter Olympics with Milan. It was the second time the games came here.
